title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program: Visit Look-Back, Follow-Up and Coverage Re-Verification Intervals
content:
Three tier intervals of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program measure how recent a practitioner visit or a payer verification must be. All three are counted in calendar months.

| Tier | Initial visit look-back (months before the order date of the initial CGM order) | Follow-up visit interval (months before each refill ship date) | Coverage re-verification interval (months back from the ship date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 6 | 12 | 12 |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 6 | 6 | 12 |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 6 | 6 | 12 |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 6 | 6 | 1 |

## What each interval is

- **Initial visit look-back**: the qualifying practitioner visit must fall within this many calendar months before the order date of the initial CGM order; 0 means no visit requirement.
- **Follow-up visit interval**: continued coverage requires a practitioner visit assessing CGM use within this many calendar months before each refill ship date; 0 means no follow-up requirement.
- **Coverage re-verification interval**: how recently the coverage record must have been verified with the payer before a refill ships, counted back from the ship date; 0 means there is no coverage to verify.

## Points of comparison

- The CGM Self-Pay Program carries 0 in all three columns.
- The CGM Commercial PPO Program allows the longest follow-up interval, 12 months.
- The CGM Medicaid Program requires the most recent verification: within 1 calendar month of the ship date.
